# R5559, page 1. My own transcription of the DECODE image of this page, as sign labels.
# A label names one sign shape of this page only. One line for each cipher row. `?` is a sign that my transcription does not read.
# Credit: DECODE record R5559, https://de-crypt.org/decrypt-web/RecordsView/5559; Archivio di Stato di Milano, Carteggio Sforzesco, cartella 1598. No DECODE image is published.
